notes: Seeded Local Terrain Mesh: Local mode now renders a real WebGL triangle/wire terrain surface deterministically derived from Agent City's existing persistent planet seed. The server keeps the seed private and exposes only a coarse 41×41, 2 m-quantized elevation field centered on Seed Site; geology, material fields, richness, and hidden deposit geometry remain behind the discovery pipeline. Citizens, structures, known locations, visitors, and route lines are visually grounded onto the mesh, with routes subdivided and draped over terrain. Local presentation has about 55% more terrain breathing room, a wider camera framing, and a flat-plane fallback if the terrain endpoint is unavailable. The 3.2× vertical relief is presentation-only; Simulation X/Y authority is unchanged.
